summary: Strategy Inc filed an 8-K (Items 7.01 and 8.01) updating its at-the-market (ATM) offering program and bitcoin holdings. The ATM program sold 19,519,801 shares of Variable Rate Series A Perpetual Stretch Preferred Stock for ~$1.95B in gross proceeds and 430,344 shares of Class A common stock netting $83.7M during May 11-17, 2026. As of May 17, 2026, the company held 843,738 BTC acquired at an average price of $75,700. Remaining capacity for ATM sales totaled $26.27B in common stock and varying amounts across preferred series. This disclosure is a routine financing and bitcoin holdings update, not a special situation event.
